source_profile.provenance: Valid custom-style LEADER DWGs for every current writer revision and one AC1024 missing-target DWG are authored from scratch by the focused C++ selector at runtime; generated drawings are removed with the temporary directory.

contract.dwg: ODA v5.4.1 §20.4.47 defines LEADER's DIMSTYLE field as a hard pointer.
contract.dxf: Autodesk LEADER (DXF) defines group 3 as the dimension-style name.
contract.required_projection: Resolve a non-null DWG DIMSTYLE pointer to the exact table name and serialize that resolved target in DWG output. Preserve STANDARD for a null model pointer. If a non-null pointer has no table target, leave the DXF group-3 name unresolved and refuse strict full conversion.

implementation.dwg_writer: DRW_Leader::encodeDwg now serializes the modeled dimStyleH.ref, defaulting to STANDARD handle 0x15 only when the model reference is zero; it no longer hard-codes every LEADER to STANDARD.
implementation.reader: dwgReader resolves a null LEADER DIMSTYLE reference to STANDARD and maps non-null references through the DIMSTYLE table, leaving a missing target empty.
implementation.dxf_writer: The shared strict DIMENSION/LEADER style-name preflight rejects empty names and names without an emitted DIMSTYLE record before opening the record scope. Direct standalone writer behavior remains outside the strict full-conversion gate.
implementation.test: The focused selector runtime-authors valid custom-style LEADER DWGs for AC1015/18/21/24/27/32 and an AC1024 missing-target DWG. It imports every valid source and checks exact custom-name resolution; the AC1024 source additionally verifies strict ASCII/Binary DXF output and typed readback, while the missing-target source verifies refusal, destination preservation, same-adapter correction retry, and typed readback.

results.custom_style_wire_roundtrip: PASS: ANSI-25 DWG hard-pointer reference is emitted and resolves to ANSI-25 on readback for all six current DWG writer revisions.
results.strict_dxf_transport: PASS: the complete AC1024 source profile writes and reads back ANSI-25 in ASCII and Binary DXF. Other writer revisions are checked through DWG source write/read; strict whole-document DXF output is not claimed for them by this selector.
results.missing_target: PASS: a non-null absent DIMSTYLE target remains unresolved after adapter retention and strict output refuses it.
results.rollback_and_retry: PASS: destination sentinels survive both refusals; restoring ANSI-25 allows the same adapter to write and read back group 3 in ASCII and Binary DXF.

sources.title: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.47 LEADER

claim_boundary: Generated LEADER DWG hard-pointer write/read across six writer revisions plus AC1024 strict DXF name projection and fail-closed behavior only. No independent physical producer breadth, annotation semantics, or native-consumer behavior is established.
